tools_lead: What runs in this project, the instances you created yourself and the catalog of tools JGates knows.
tools_empty: You have not created any instance yet. The tools above already run through the templates; create an instance to tune one of them.
tools_effective_title: Tools in use in this project
tools_effective_lead: What the plan runs today, by category. It comes from the templates or from an instance of yours; open a tool to see and adjust its settings.
tools_effective_loading: Building the plan to see what runs...
tools_effective_failed: The plan could not be built now: {error}
tools_effective_none: The plan of this project does not run any tool yet.
tools_scope_note: Project languages: {languages}. A search looks through the whole catalog.
tools_scope_note_none: A search looks through the whole catalog.
tools_scope_hidden: {count, plural, one {# more tool for other languages is under "All".} other {# more tools for other languages are under "All".}}
tools_own_edit_lead: This tool is yours. The six steps open filled in so you can change the command, the arguments, the report and what it checks.
tools_settings_lead: The keys of {tool} in .jgates/tools.yml: on, required, time limit, what it checks and the adapter's options.

ctl_keep_extension: Runs in the project's own image.

tools_no_match: Nothing matches the search and the filters.

tools_governed: In governed mode tool instances are fixed: JGates shows them, but does not create, rename or remove.
tools_dialog_id_help: Lowercase letters, numbers, dot, hyphen and underscore. Example: eslint-web.

tools_dialog_remove_lead: The instance leaves .jgates/tools.yml. Its configuration files are not deleted.
tools_dialog_refs: These files still mention tool:{tool}: {files}. Adjust the selection in them.
tools_err_INSTANCE_ID_INVALID: The name can only have lowercase letters, numbers, dot, hyphen and underscore, and starts with a letter or number.
tools_err_INSTANCE_EXISTS: An instance with that name already exists.
tools_err_ADAPTER_UNKNOWN: JGates does not know that tool.
tools_err_COMPONENT_UNKNOWN: The component does not exist in this workspace.
tools_err_TOOLS_FILE_CONFLICT: tools.yml changed on disk while you were editing. Reload the list and try again.
tools_err_TOOLS_FILE_INVALID: tools.yml has a syntax error and was not changed.
tools_path_catalog_help: A tool JGates already knows, attached to a component.
tools_path_own_help: A tool of yours: JGates installs it, runs it and reads its result.
ctl_obtain_install: Install it in the JGates environment
ctl_image_missing: Docker does not have this image. Pull it before continuing.
ctl_image_arch_bad: The image is for {arch}; JGates uses linux/amd64.
ctl_image_note: JGates pins the image by its identifier the first time it uses it.
ctl_method_binary: Binary downloaded from an address, with SHA-256
ctl_lines_title: Lines that will be added to the Dockerfile
ctl_args_help: Each line becomes one argument, without going through a shell.
ctl_ph_output: the folder where the tool writes its report
ctl_network: Needs the network when it runs
ctl_format_sarif_help: Findings with file, line and severity. The most common format of analysis and security tools.
ctl_format_junit_help: Test results: which passed and which failed.
ctl_format_checkstyle_help: Style findings in XML, with file and line.
ctl_format_exit_code_help: The exit code of the command decides. It does not point to a file or line.
ctl_file_help: The command has to write it to {output}/{file}.
ctl_verify_lead: Check what this tool verifies. This decides which validations it joins.
ctl_review_lead: These are the exact changes to add {id}. Nothing has been written yet.
ctl_effect_network: When it runs, the tool has network access.
ctl_effect_no_network: When it runs, the tool has no network.
ctl_effect_build: The own image will be built later, with network, only when you ask.
ctl_effect_no_build: No own image needs to be built.
ctl_effect_untested: The tool stays marked as not tested until its first successful run.

ctl_test_progress: Building the image and running the tool. This can take a few minutes.
ctl_result_ok: The tool ran and the report was read: no findings.
ctl_result_findings: {count, plural, one {The tool ran and the report was read: # finding.} other {The tool ran and the report was read: # findings.}}
ctl_result_unreadable: The tool ran, but its report could not be read.
ctl_result_build_failed: The own image could not be built.
ctl_result_not_found: The tool did not enter this project's plan.
ctl_discard_lead: The tool has not been saved yet. If you close now, everything you filled in is lost.

ctl_err_CAPABILITY_REQUIRED: Check at least one thing the tool verifies.

ctl_err_IMAGE_AND_INSTALL: Choose a ready image or installing, not both.
